title: State accords administrative sanction for ₹100 crore for Kotipalli-Narsapuram railway line
description: It is in line with its commitment to share 25% of the total project cost; Amalapuram MP Harish Balayogi says it will help speed up the project, which was the brainchild of his father and first Dalit Lok Sabha Speaker G.M.C. Balayogi
